name: Pyromancer Descension of Executus and Ragnaros supersede lower ranks (#13194)
contract: In Spell.dbc, Pyromancer's aura-bar spells are named 'Descension of Executus' (ranks 1-5: 1119754-1119758) and
matched only the pre-rebrand prefix 'Ascension of ', leaving IsStackableWithRanks() true for Descension ranks so
Player::addSpell never marked superseded ranks inactive or sent SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL and every rank appeared as
a separate button on the aura bar. After matching both 'Ascension of ' and 'Descension of ', learning ranks 1-4 of
Descension of Executus and ranks 1-3 of Descension of Ragnaros must leave only the highest rank active and in the
client spellbook (both immediately and after relog), prevent casting superseded ranks, and allow casting the
